mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lucky_draw_prize (product_id, product_name, product_quantity, activity_id, redemption_code) VALUES (#{productId}, #{productName}, #{productQuantity}, #{activityId}, #{redemptionCode})
mapper.update: UPDATE lucky_draw_prize SET product_name = #{productName}, product_quantity = #{productQuantity}, activity_id = #{activityId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE prize_id = #{prizeId}
mapper.select:
SELECT p.prize_id, p.product_id, p.product_name, p.product_quantity, p.activity_id, a.activity_name, p.redemption_code, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM lucky_draw_prize p inner join lucky_draw_activity a on p.activity_id = a.activity_id
AND p.activity_id = #{activityId}
AND a.activity_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{activityName}, '%')
AND p.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productName}, '%')
ORDER BY prize_id

SELECT p.prize_id, p.product_id, p.product_name, p.product_quantity, p.activity_id, a.activity_name, p.redemption_code, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM lucky_draw_prize p inner join lucky_draw_activity a on p.activity_id = a.activity_id WHERE prize_id = #{prizeId}
SELECT prize_id, product_id, product_name, product_quantity, activity_id, redemption_code, created_at, updated_at FROM lucky_draw_prize WHERE redemption_code = #{redemptionCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT p.product_id as productId, p.product_name AS productName, p.product_image AS productImage, p.product_price AS productPrice, p.product_levelid AS productLevelId, p.product_badge as productBadge, p.product_spirit_power as productSpiritPower, p.created_by AS createdBy, p.created_time AS createdTime, p.updated_by AS updatedBy, p.updated_time AS updatedTime FROM product p where p.product_seriesid is null ORDER BY p.product_id
